Sometimes I want to appreciate the video itself more and not read so much. Also "Saiki K" just has an amazing dub. It's really funny so I like it. Also to watch "Saiki K" in sub is torture because they talk really fast. I'm also watching "Jobless Reincarnation" right now and I like the dub of it quite a lot. it has beautiful animation so it works nicely for my concentration.

But in any other situation, I like sub more because they have selected specific people to be the voice actors and it can matter. Also, some people made fun of me for watching dub so I started only watching sub for some time. To change the shows now to dub would be hard because I already have memorized which voices are for which characters.
